> Still cPitchPal is a pocket-sized Tamagotchi-style virtual pet for soccer fans. It's a little striker you feed, train, and keep rested. It runs on an ESP32-C3 with a 1.3" OLED, three buttons, and a buzzer, and lives in a custom 3D-printed shell I'm designing myself. Its stats (hunger, energy, happiness, fitness) change over time and are saved to flash, so it keeps living when switched off. Mini-games include penalty kicks and juggling, and it evolves based on how well I look after it. Stretch goal: Wi-Fi time sync, plus a status page hosted on my homelab.oming up with the ideas
